digest.component_or_area: tickets store fetch and bootstrap in CI workflows
propositions: Fresh full clone of tickets costs 1.04 GiB / 59s wall, while --filter=blob:none costs 68.7 MiB / 14.3s, achieving ~15x reduction in CI checkout time
When tickets fetch times out, rebar silently bootstraps an orphan empty store instead of failing closed, causing divergence from origin/tickets and returning empty reads
blob:none partial clone preserves the complete commit graph for merge-base ancestry scoping and verify-identity checks while keeping blobs lazy-fetched from working tree
rebar cannot apply filter flags to clones it does not perform; the checkout filter must be set in actions/checkout before rebar runs
With merge.ours.driver undefined, reconverge against diverged remote fails when git attempts 3-way text merge of 18 MB .bridge_state JSON
git blame over historical trees on the bug-close path must be re-measured and may degrade under blob:none but is an accepted cost
